final: WITH counts_by_type AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) as order_count FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as overall_avg FROM counts_by_type), above_avg AS (SELECT cbt.order_count FROM counts_by_type cbt, avg_calc WHERE cbt.order_count > avg_calc.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_of_above_avg_counts, AVG(order_count - (SELECT overall_avg FROM avg_calc)) as avg_excess_over_avg FROM above_avg
